player_input.text: I ask who still remembers the old north road.

narration.speaker: game-master
narration.text: The room quiets. A woman behind the bar — broad shoulders, ash-grey hair — sets down a chipped blue bowl and looks you over.

contributions.speaker: mara-underbough
contributions.text: Old roads remember old debts. If you mean the north stones, buy a bowl first and do not say the Ashford name too loudly.

claims.text: Mara warned the player not to say the Ashford name loudly.
They say the north stones move when no one watches.

value.summary: Mara Underbough warned the player not to say the Ashford name loudly.
The old north road and its stones are tied to old debts.
